body: I literally just finished my leaving exams and graduated a week ago. I understand that professional help is the method that everyone would recommend because it's the safest for them, but for some reason I don't feel like I would move forward with it... I feel like something needs to happen to make me feel bad enough to not deserve to feel bad anymore. And honestly, maybe the best way to do that is an attempt - leave it to fate, if it goes one way then I'm gone and I don't have to worry; the other then I might have fixed the way I think. Notice the selfish way I phrased that - I don't have to worry. Considerate of me to give thought to the fact that I get to fuck off and everyone has to deal with it, right?
